meta.title: VIGIE, survival roguelite | Izacki
meta.description: VIGIE is a free survival roguelite for Windows: keep a lighthouse, aim the beam and choose your relics, night after night.
meta.imageAlt: VIGIE, “Garde la lumière” (Keep the light): the lighthouse and its beam among the creatures of the sea.

hero.lead: A lighthouse lost in the middle of the sea, a lamp, creatures rising from the waves: aim the beam and hold out until dawn.

play.label: Basics
play.title: Keep the light.
play.p1: You are the keeper of a remote lighthouse. Every night lasts seven minutes: creatures rise from the sea and throw themselves at the light. Your weapon is the beam of the lamp: you aim it with the mouse, focus it by holding the click (it uses energy) and fire a flare to clear the surroundings.
play.p2: Every defeated creature leaves a glimmer. At each level, a revelation offers you three relics and you keep only one. There are 25 of them, with synergies: Prisme (Prism: two, then three beams), Écho (Echo), Phare jumeau (Twin Lighthouse), Chaleur (Heat), Givre (Frost), Foudre (Lightning), Phénix (Phoenix)… No two nights are alike.
play.p3: Eight creatures, eight ways to get in your way: the Rôdeur (Prowler) charges, the Voile (Veil) flees the light, the Méduse (Jellyfish) freezes the lamp, the Sirène (Siren) snatches it away, the Crabe de pierre (Stone Crab) clings to the lighthouse, the Baudroie (Anglerfish) protects the others. At dawn, a boss: the Léviathan (Leviathan) in three phases, and, from Abysse I (Abyss I) onwards, the Kraken with four tentacles. Events punctuate the night: a school of lanternfish, an eclipse, a full moon, a wreck to plunder.
play.p4: Between nights, the shards you earn upgrade your lighthouse for good (12 upgrades). Four guardians, each with a different style: Le Gardien (the Keeper), L'Horloger (the Clockmaker), L'Ermite (the Hermit), La Veuve (the Widow). Nine abyss levels to toughen up the sea, a daily challenge, 16 achievements and three save slots.
play.names: The names of relics, creatures and guardians are those of the game, which is in French.
